topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When we received the news, my sister and I stood in the kitchen, the place where we used to gather for storytelling and cookies, and we shared a look that needed no words. Grandmother’s house, filled with the echoes of our laughter and the scent of her lavender, was now ours. We explored every corner, from the attic’s dusty treasures to the well-tended garden, each spot a reminder of the lessons she taught us. Together, we decided to keep it just as she left it, a sanctuary where family could always come home.
